core_memory.user_introduction_michael: Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics in gadgets, interested in high-quality coffee machines to enhance his morning routine.
core_memory.user_inquiry_pricing: Michael is interested in pricing for espresso machines, specifically looking for first-time buyer discounts, new customer offers, and any bundle or limited-time promotions.
core_memory.user_shipping_inquiry: Michael is in Seattle and is concerned about shipping times and origin. He wants to know if products are shipped from a local warehouse, and if not, what the delivery timeline is—especially since he's hosting a family gathering later this month.
core_memory.user_additional_questions: Michael is asking detailed questions about the espresso machine's brewing frequency, cleaning complexity, footprint size, and overall kitchen space impact. He wants to ensure the device fits seamlessly into his lifestyle and home environment.
core_memory.user_warranty_inquiry: Michael wants a long-term, customer-friendly warranty for espresso machines, especially for premium models, to ensure reliability and easy support.
core_memory.user_temperature_preference: Michael is concerned about coffee temperature consistency and wants to know if espresso machines offer adjustable temperature settings or reliably produce hot coffee to avoid microwaving.
core_memory.user_delivery_preparation_instructions: Michael will be available to receive the package in person, especially during rain. He requires a signature on delivery to prevent the package from being left unattended or damaged. He wants to greet the courier and ensure the box is safely brought inside.
